name: Default Artemis Deployment Context
unresolvedNotes: Since profile version 2.0.0 a deployment profile is a pure capability manifest: it declares which integrations the deployment context supports, never their runtime values.

Since profile version 3.0.0 the bundled default profile declares no providedCapabilities: it provides every capability the active feature model requires, and the capability ids are derived from the model features' deployment inputs as <feature>-service and <feature>-secret.

A provided capability means the context supports or permits the integration and provides a path for supplying its runtime requirements; concrete values are supplied through the deployment environment and validated at runtime.
Technical axes are selected by feature-model features. The legacy database.type, deployment.mode, and ci.provider parameters were removed and are never authoritative.
A maintainer local override may declare an explicit providedCapabilities list to restrict the available integrations; the list is then authoritative.
